name: Frostfield
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target or Area 30-ft. radius burst, or one spellcaster, creature, or spell
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell creates a field of magic frost that coats everything within its area. All mundane fires up to the size of a bonfire are immediately extinguished by this frost. Creatures of the fire subtype take 3d6 cold damage. Frostfield can also be used against spells with the [fire] descriptor in the same way a dispel magic spell can be, including being able to attempt to counterspell any [fire] spell.
